Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to Enlisted ( Electrical) Contractor of RAjuk or Other Govt./ Semi Govt./ Autonomous
Organization/ Reputed Bonafied Firm as mentioned below as further detailed in the Tender Data Sheet (TDS) as well as
Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC) of the Tender Document.
a) The Tenderer having minimum 05 ( Five) years general experience of electro--mechanical works .
b) The Tenderer shall have successfully Completed of 01 (One ) No LED Street Light Works of minimum amount Tk.30.00
(Thirty) Lacs single Contract within last 05 ( Five) years Under in Govt./ Semi Govt./ Autonomous body. i.e Counting
backward from the date of publication of IFT in the News Paper/ Website.
c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 35.00 (Thirty
five) Lacs only.
d) Annual Electro - Mechanical Turnover : Last five years ( Financial year 2015-2016, 2016-2017 , 2017-2018, 2018-2019,
2019-2020 ) average Annual Turnover should be required minimum amount Tk.30.00 ( Thirty) Lacs.
e) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC category Contractory & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh Electrical
Licensing Board.
f) The Tenderer must have Income Tax clearance Certificate (2019-2020).
g) The Tenderer must have VAT/BIN Registration Certificate.
h) The Tenderer must have valid Trade License (2020-2021)
